decisions.statement: The level now is the level the open tracking session has.
The level a day has is the last level that day's sessions have.
A session with no level is passed over rather than read as the day's level.
A day no session has a level on is no reading rather than a level of zero.
A level moves in half steps.
A level below zero is a level.
A level stated as text is read as the number that level spells.
No open session is no reading rather than a level of zero.
An open session with no level is no reading rather than a level of zero.
Nothing here caches a reading or decides when a reading is taken.
Nothing here turns a level into a color.
